shrinkage.shooting: 100 recorded attempts at league training shooting mean, then inverse curve. Missing players get league mean; nonshooting skills often70.
shrinkage.defense: Box/position prior + game-CV player ridge; signal centered at training league.
shrinkage.warning: Analytic EV is an additive diagnostic proxy, not full game PPP. Post coefficients diagnosed here are never engine inputs; sparse low-minute residuals remain regularized and correlated.

unshrunkDiagnostic.definition: Unpenalized MLE residual on the same pre41 scoring model and box/role prior, fixed centered gauge. Coefficients of unobserved or collinear players are not uniquely identified; an optimizer representative only, never engine inputs. All new-model values are relative log-rate effects times training league100PPP, not OVR or causal player ratings.
